overallOutcome: Passed bounded native scope. No confirmed Settings Add continuity failure in current retained pixels; full compositor/U9 and physical performance certification outside scope.

emptySettings.wide: Actual1200x700 simple saved empty state: prominent Add, inactive editor/credential cards hidden, Save locally/footer visible. Direct Add visibly opens draft editor; actual Cancel returns helper0 and accepted empty revision unchanged.
emptySettings.compact: Actual1024x700 saved empty state with prominent Add and hidden inactive cards; direct Add opens draft editor; actual Cancel leaves accepted empty revision unchanged.
emptySettings.continuity: Repeated border/native-menu width changes and settled screenshots retain Add. Previously reported absence was observer error, corrected by independent root review, exact hashes and actual blue button pixels. No verified transient/settled absence claim.

configuredSettings.compact: Actual1024x700 simple and expanded Advanced readable, nav and footer visible. Capture/Shortcuts/Preferences actual sections inspected.
configuredSettings.wide: Actual1200x700 expanded Advanced and collapsed simple readable, nav and footer visible. Capture/Shortcuts/Preferences actual sections inspected.
configuredSettings.draft: Appended d to saved synthetic bucket. synthetic-ui-onlyd visible after compact expansion, section switches, collapse and wide resize/navigation/collapse. Actual Cancel discarded draft; reopened bucket synthetic-ui-only. Accepted configured revision unchanged.
configuredSettings.keyboard: Both widths: Tab from Capture navigation visibly focuses Save locally; ShiftTab returns to Capture navigation. Footer Cancel was actually clicked and reachable at both widths. Complete keyboard traversal of every control to footer was not claimed.

history.scope: Opened/normal closed/reopened/normal closed; actual populated native list from this candidate matrix inspected. Further inspector/copy/preview scenarios intentionally outside bounded repeat.
history.visible: 11 synthetic records; Name/date/upload/local/remote columns readable; local-only/saved/not-requested outcomes visible.

activity.scope: Opened/normal closed/reopened/normal closed; actual12-operation native tree inspected. Parent/child Copy result/full-ID/independent paste repeats outside bounded scope.
activity.visible: Matrix completed local-only/copied outcomes and three cancelled region operations visible; current native reopen PNG exactly matches opening SHA256.

closeTray.renderedTray: Actual final-tray-completed native image shows rendered put.gd icon and tooltip put.gd — Share and local capture.

limitations: History inspector/copy/preview and Activity parent/child Copy result/full-ID/paste extra scenarios skipped per bounded scope; source43 evidence not relabelled as current.
Complete every-control keyboard-to-footer traversal not established; native Capture Tab/ShiftTab and actual footer Cancel interaction were established at both widths.
No physical timing, memory, cold/quiet/performance budget or fullU9 acceptance claim; no VM lifecycle/base/toolchain/cloud actions.
Source metadata comparison prose says Base44; actual frozen source identity is commitCount45 and is recorded exactly here.

observerCorrection.actualOutcome: Both are byte-identical and show Add. Label naming and initial observer impression are not product failure evidence. Recovery-collapsed also shows Add.
